d: The Raipur-Vizag Expressway (NH-130CD) is a 464-kilometer, six-lane, greenfield expressway under construction in India. It will connect Raipur in Chhattisgarh to Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, passing through Odisha. This ambitious project is part of the Bharatmala Pariyojana Phase-I & is expected to significantly reduce travel time & enhance connectivity between these regions. It is estimated to cost around ₹20,000 crore & is being constructed in multiple packages by various contractors. The expressway is designed to boost trade, stimulate economic growth, & improve transportation…
